findings.issue: The PR normalizes CRLF bytes inside 110 WebP assets across app/static/examples and cloudflare/public/static/examples. Every affected image fails decoding, breaking the gallery and prompt examples. Restore the main-branch binary bytes and exempt WebP files from the broad text rules in .gitattributes.

redactText consumes only the Bearer/Basic scheme in Authorization values and leaves the actual credential; URLs with username/password but no query are also preserved. Public artwork exports and gallery prompt/title metadata therefore leak these sensitive values despite the issue's privacy contract.

Edit records hardcode the legacy history seed sentinel to 0, and pendingReceipt copies it as an effective provider seed. Neither edit backend sends or returns a seed, so edit receipts must record null rather than claim the provider used seed 0.

summary: Fixed three defects: restored 110 corrupted WebP assets with binary attributes, removed complete Authorization credentials and URL userinfo from public exports/share metadata, and recorded unknown edit seeds as null. All fixes have failing-before/passing-after regression evidence; the Git-Bash full gate passed 475 tests plus 30 Python subtests and the three existing browser QA scripts, and the local Worker build passed. No needs-human findings remain; no push or deployment was performed.
